summary: The candidate validly prevents unsupported compact target-verify capture and keeps Triton-backed Qwen hybrid verification eager. It is a partial crash-avoidance fix, not compact CUDA-graph support, and the original B300/CUDA 13.2 kernel failure remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression against the recorded base: five tests passed and unsupported compact capture failed by entering warmup, reproducing the capture-admission defect without reproducing the GPU IMA.
At exact candidate commit, all six mocked capability, capture, and eager-replay admission tests passed.
Independent boundaries: all hybrid child-capability combinations, repeated unsupported compact capture, eager replay admission, supported compact capture, and non-compact capture.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate behavior was tested through Python control flow only. Runtime inventory found AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2; no candidate kernel/model execution was performed.

remaining_counterexamples: Triton-backed Qwen hybrid compact target verification still does not use a CUDA graph; capture and replay are deliberately routed to eager execution.
The NVIDIA B300/CUDA 13.2 illegal memory access at batch size 20 and eight tokens per request was not reproduced or retested on matching hardware and weights.
The regression and adversarial checks do not execute extend_attention_fwd or a hybrid full-attention/GatedDeltaNet model.
remaining_limitations: Assigned hardware is AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA B300 with CUDA 13.2.
Required Qwen hybrid and DSpark model weights were unavailable.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes Python, tests, and reports only.
